message: No detected input validation: The code reads CSV files via pandas read_csv and immediately extracts values with iloc without any schema checks, dtype assertions, shape guards, or value-range validations.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local filesystem paths only (DATASET_PATH + filename); no remote sources, checksums, or integrity verification are present.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering is applied to training samples at any point in the data preparation flow.

No detected model integrity verification: Models are created fresh via Models.random_forest(), Models.ada_boost(), Models.decision_tree(), and Models.dnn() and fitted from scratch; no pretrained weights or serialized models are loaded, so no integrity verification is performed.

No detected label distribution validation: The code computes class counts (pos/neg) only to derive an initial bias for the DNN output layer, not to validate or check the label distribution for anomalies or imbalance.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse, activation-pattern analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense in the training code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or used anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) or robustness stress tests are used anywhere in the evaluation code.
No detected input sanitization: The code reads CSV files and passes data directly to models without any shape, range, or schema validation checks.
No detected output bounds checks: Predictions from get_all_predictions and model.evaluate are used directly without any NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or sanity validation on the outputs.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The models used are tabular classifiers (Random Forest, DNN, Ada Boost, Decision Tree), not LLMs, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
